Riley (CSM): Quick week0 check for MarineCore private/VPC. Main asks: confirm networking, IAM trust, KMS access, and audit retention. Any blockers?

Priya (CS Ops): Peering established, subnets OK. Customer needs specific egress IPs for firewall rule; asked to confirm tomorrow.

Ibrahim (NetEng): Shared IP list: api.redwood-inference.com resolves to 52.17.210.7/32 and 52.17.210.8/32. Also need outbound to s3-us-east-1.amazonaws.com. Recommend NAT in public subnet.

Sam (Security): IAM: their AssumeRole failing due to missing ExternalId. Sent trust policy snippet with ExternalId requirement.

Priya (CS Ops): KMS: saw kms:Decrypt denied on boot. They supplied CMK but key policy omitted our cross-account role. Sent minimal key policy to add kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey.

AuditBot: Audit-forwarding check: retention=90d (default). Customer requested 730d. Flag: renewal-risk if not extended before cutover.

Riley (CSM): Actions: Priya to post runbook snippets and DM customer (owner: Priya). Ibrahim to confirm IPs and NAT note (owner: Ibrahim). Sam to validate KMS once policy applied (owner: Sam). I'll schedule verification call Friday 11am PT.

Priya (CS Ops): Runbook updated: /runbooks/marinecore/week0. Snippets posted and DM sent.

Ibrahim (NetEng): IP list confirmed and NAT note added.

Sam (Security): KMS re-test pending customer change. Monitoring.

Riley (CSM): Thanks team 1f44d. Will log renewal-watch: "audit retention increase required (730d)" as CS-2109. Closing initial triage here.
